jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established experts to sit on an advisory committee, not a genuine paid entry-level role; it seeks recognised expertise (activists and specialists from the named regions) that the candidate does not have. The Spanish-language convocatoria and regional focus also imply working expertise the candidate lacks, and there is no salaried vacancy here.
